mentions.name: Magic Spell Language and Compiler
mentions.description: This project defines a system-agnostic language for magic spells, together with a compiler that outputs the components needed to perform each spell, such as wand movements, incantations, hand signs, or magic circles.
mentions.source_excerpt: A system-agnostic language for magic spells with a compiler capable of producing the magic wand movements, incantation, hand signs or magic circle required to perform the spell
